services.name: Public website and private admin UI

language.question: Which language should the Angular frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Angular's standard typed language for maintainable browser applications.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Angular frontend implemented without TypeScript type checking.

framework.question: Which framework should power the frontend?

options.label: Angular
options.description: Component-based frontend with routing, forms, and HTTP client support.

features.question: Describe the required frontend pages and interactions.
features.answer: Elegant, classy, minimalist public Home, Pricelist, Gallery, and Contact Us pages; hidden footer entry point to email/password hairdresser login; authenticated pricelist editing and password-change UI; responsive accessibility-focused layout; contact details, links, and map image with no contact form; dynamic copyright year.
features.recommendedChoice: Public marketing pages plus a private authenticated editor

language.question: Which language should the API use?

options.label: Python
options.description: Python backend language requested for the FastAPI service.

framework.question: Which framework should power the backend API?

features.question: Describe the API and authentication behavior.
features.answer: FastAPI JSON API for gallery metadata, media, health/readiness checks, and scraper-run records; services and contact details are maintained outside the database.
features.recommendedChoice: FastAPI with public gallery and health endpoints

language.question: Which language should the daily gallery scraper use?

options.label: Python
options.description: Reuse the backend ecosystem and the requested instagram-scraper package.

framework.question: Which worker approach should run the daily scrape?

options.label: Scheduled Python worker
options.description: Containerized scheduled process using the instagram-scraper package.

features.question: Describe the daily gallery synchronization behavior.
features.answer: Daily idempotent scrape of https://www.instagram.com/jewelessencehairstudio/?hl=en using https://github.com/drawrowfly/instagram-scraper; validate, deduplicate, retain a bounded gallery, persist metadata and downloaded media, and expose scrape status/errors.
features.recommendedChoice: Daily scheduled scrape with retries, rate limiting, audit logs, and manual re-run capability

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Pricelist, admin account, gallery metadata, scrape runs, and site configuration.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Downloaded Instagram gallery images and the map image asset.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use only if the application has no persistence or file/media storage.

sharedQuestions.question: Do users need to sign in for application API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Hairdresser signs in to edit the pricelist and change the password.
